decisions.reason: As a flagship launch in the firm's cloud messaging direction, it is likely still at or near aspiration and protected by strategic commitment and organisational slack despite lower later visibility.

This legacy-bridging email and fax service is less central to the future portfolio, but for German business and public-sector customers it can still justify retention unless results clearly fall below aspiration.
Because this fax optimization offer is very close to the core platform and probably inexpensive to maintain, management would usually keep it unless performance distinctly disappoints.
Threat protection directly supports the firm's secure and compliant value proposition, so in a growing market it is likely to remain above aspiration or be sustained as a strategic capability.
Multi-engine virus scanning complements the messaging platform and customer expectations for security, making retention more likely than withdrawal even if it is not a highly visible growth product.
